name: DisplaySelectFromListDialog
label: Display Select From List Dialog
description: Displays a dialog box with options that lets the user select from a list.

fields.name: DialogTitle
fields.label: Dialog Title
fields.description: The title text displayed at the top of the dialog window.

fields.name: DialogMessage
fields.label: Dialog Message
fields.description: The message or prompt shown inside the dialog to guide the user.

fields.name: ListToChooseFrom
fields.label: List to Choose From
fields.description: A list of items from which the user can select one or more options.

fields.name: KeepOnTop
fields.label: Keep Select Dialog Always On Top
fields.description: If true, keeps the dialog window always on top of other windows.

fields.name: LimitToList
fields.label: Limit to List
fields.description: If true, limits user input to only the items in the provided list.

fields.name: AllowEmptySelection
fields.label: Allow Empty Selection
fields.description: If true, allows the user to make no selection (optional choice).

fields.name: AllowMultipleSelection
fields.label: Allow Multiple Selection
fields.description: If true, allows the user to select multiple items from the list.

fields.name: PreselectItemsStartingWithPlus
fields.label: Preselect Items Starting With '+'
fields.description: If true, preselects all items in the list that start with a '+' character.

fields.name: SelectedItem
fields.label: Selected Item(s)
fields.description: Returns the selected item(s) from the dialog as a string. For multiple selections, items are separated by commas.

fields.name: SelectedIndex
fields.label: Selected Index(es)
fields.description: Returns the index or indices of the selected item(s) in the list.

fields.name: ButtonPressed
fields.label: Button Pressed
fields.description: Returns true if the user pressed the OK button; false if Cancel or closed the dialog.
